instruction: The precondition assembly file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the starting assembly shown in the before image. Complete the assembly so it matches the target shape shown in the after image while using the correct physical joint behavior. Toggle Grounded for the blue part. Assemble the rollers to the blue part with Cylindrical Joints as shown in the expected image. Each roller cylindrical joint should use enabled axial limits within the eligible -3 mm to 3 mm range, while the angle setting remains 0. Clone rollers as needed. Save the completed assembly to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
